items.description: Turns the head and looks at you on hearing her name.
Sits on the verbal cue or the hand signal.
Comes to you when called. Special reward: boiled chicken.
Walks next to you on a loose leash.
Lies down following the reward from nose to floor.
Moves away from a closed hand or something on the ground.
Holds a sit for a few seconds until released.
Relieves herself in the usual spot.
